snippet.title: Decollate Decoration - Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
A haunting adventure where love lingers beyond death!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3155570/Decollate_Decoration/

Overview
This title is a point-and-click, command-selection adventure game starring a girl who has become a ghost. Players guide her actions and choices as she attempts to fulfill her lingering desires, experimenting with supernatural methods to influence the living world. With multiple endings and a compact playtime, the game is designed for replayability and narrative discovery.

Story
One day, without warning, the protagonist awakens as a ghost. She believes she lived without evil and that her soul should be judged kindly, yet the fear of being separated from the one she loves overwhelms everything else. Unable to accept a future apart, she resolves to stay close to him at any cost. Whether by appearing in dreams, stirring strange phenomena, or invoking darker powers, she pursues a single goal before her soul passes on: to bring her beloved to her side.
